Design With Us

Have an idea? Let's shape it together.

Send a photo of an heirloom, a screenshot of something you love, or just a description of what's in your head. We'll turn it into a wearable design, together, before anything is made.

  • 1

  • 3

Payment links

Set these up once. They're used for the "Pay Now" buttons customers see in their design thread.

In the Yoco App: Sales → Payment Page, to get your permanent link. Customers can enter their own amount, or you can generate a link for an exact amount per request (Sales → Payment Link) and paste that into a specific request below instead.

Capitec app → Transact → Pay me → My QR. Heads up: this only works if your customer is also a Capitec client — it can't take cards or other banks. Worth offering as a second option, not your only one.
